answer: The protocol gates agent identity by requiring 1,000 unique computational puzzles, ensuring that 1,000 fakes cost 1,000 times more than one honest agent. A verifier scans every submission like a cipher parsing a locked vault, treating any duplicate work as a flaw. Each agent functions as an oasis of unique compute, forced to solve puzzles that defy pooling. A comet-like trail of evidence is logged, and any reuse triggers permanent account locking without refund.
